methodology.order: before/after, after/before, before/after at each row count
methodology.seed_scope: one shared original chat; edited and appended rows move to updated chat
methodology.timing: Only Database::insert_rows, including validation, index maintenance and (durable) WAL encoding/fsync; excludes input generation, HTTP, embedding providers, fixture loading and checkpoints
methodology.percentiles: Median of three process medians and three process p95 values; with seven samples the within-process p95 is the maximum
methodology.correctness: Each variant checks exact scoped IDs, order and scores against a full-scan/full-sort reference; durable reopen repeats the comparison and checks row count
methodology.build_isolation: Baseline and updated benchmark binaries have distinct SHA-256 digests. Cleared package release artifacts after switching source trees; discarded the earlier colliding-cache run.

limitations: Synthetic vectors do not measure semantic recall or provider latency.
100000 regular SQL rows tested, not ten million documents. GraphRAG capacity remains 10000 chunks.
Writes remain serialized; active snapshots can copy table metadata; durable checkpoints still write the whole catalog.
